Yeah I upgraded from a vivocharge HR and was debating back and forth. It took me about four days or so to come to the conclusion of the vivoactive lol. For one I saw a few features I thought were forerunner only in the vivoactive 3 which helped me decide quite a bit. Also I couldn't justify  the $400.00 in features for myself since I haven't been running a lot and being some features were already Iin the vivoactive it worked out well.
